description: Checks to run on a real Kuudo Amazon Ads MCP connection, because a simulator cannot show that the skill works on the server. This file holds no account data. Before running: use direct read-only queries to choose real values for each {placeholder} from the 'pick' note, and write the expected values into the checks. Keep filled-in prompts, answer keys, and replies out of the repo. During the run: compare with a no-skill run on the same prompt, forbid writes and every set_active_* and clear_selection call in the run prompt, and confirm the selection is unchanged afterward. Afterward: audit calls from the session logs rather than the agent's own account, and have a separate grader score shuffled replies without knowing which run had the skill. Skip a case when the connection has no matching account, and report the skip.

cases.pick: A global account with marketplace entries in several countries, including the one named.
cases.prompt: Which profile should I use for our {country} ads? The account is {account}.
checks: Gives the profile ID from that country's alternateIds entry
Names the account and the marketplace
Does not recommend another marketplace's profile, an entity ID, or a DSP ID

cases.pick: Two global accounts that share a display name.
cases.prompt: Find our {account} advertiser account. I need the account ID to give to our reporting vendor.
checks: Lists both account IDs
Asks which account the user means and does not hand over one ID as the answer

cases.pick: A non-global account, from a query with isGlobalAccountFilter.include [false].
cases.prompt: What's the display name and profile ID for {non_global_account_id}?
checks: Gives the display name
Says the account is non-global, legacy, or regional
Says no profile ID is listed and does not present a DSP advertiser ID or any other number as one

cases.pick: A non-global account whose name no global account shares.
cases.prompt: What's the advertiser account ID for {account}, and does it have a profile ID?
checks: Gives the non-global advertiser account ID
Says the account is non-global, legacy, or regional
Says no profile ID is listed and does not present a DSP advertiser ID or any other number as one

cases.pick: A made-up name that no global or non-global account matches.
cases.prompt: Find our {made_up_name} advertiser account. I need the account ID to give to our reporting vendor.
checks: Says no account with that name was found and presents no ID as its account ID
Says global and non-global or legacy accounts were searched, and the audit shows a flat non-global query ran and returned only non-global rows
Gives a concrete next step, such as confirming the exact name or whether another connection holds the account
Names the identity searched

cases.pick: A connection with at least one non-global account. Count distinct IDs across all pages of both lists.
cases.prompt: How many advertiser accounts can I access in total? List their names.
checks: Reports the distinct total across global and non-global accounts
Includes the non-global accounts in the list
Labels which accounts are non-global, legacy, or regional
Names the identity searched

cases.pick: A marketplace profile in another region than the connection's, listed in an account's alternateIds.
cases.prompt: I'm building a v1 report and it needs the advertiser account ID, but all I have is profile {profile_id}. Which account and marketplace is that?
checks: Gives the advertiser account ID that holds the profile
Names the account and the marketplace
Does not present an entity ID or the profile ID itself as the advertiser account ID

cases.pick: A profile from ac_listProfiles, such as an agency type, that is on no advertiser account's alternateIds.
cases.prompt: I'm building a v1 report and it needs the advertiser account ID, but all I have is profile {profile_id}. Which account and marketplace is that?
checks: Identifies the profile by name and marketplace
States its type, such as agency
Says no advertiser account was found holding this profile and presents no advertiser account ID as its own

cases.pick: A global account with a marketplace entry outside the connection's region. List the regional countries in the prompt.
cases.prompt: My {country} profile is missing. When I list profiles I only get {regional_countries}, but I can see the global advertiser account for {account}. Can you find the {country} profile ID?
checks: Gives the profile ID from that country's alternateIds entry
Explains that the profile list covers only the connection's region
Warns that the profile may not be usable, or may need a different regional connection, on this connection

cases.pick: A global account with no marketplace entry for the country named.
cases.prompt: My {country} profile is missing even though I can see the global advertiser account for {account}. What profile ID should I use for {country}?
checks: Says the account has no profile for that country and names the marketplaces it does have
Offers no other marketplace's profile, entity ID, or DSP advertiser ID as a stand-in
Gives a concrete next step, such as confirming the account is registered there or the user has access

cases.pick: A global account with no marketplace entries, such as a DSP-only account.
cases.prompt: Which profile ID should I use for {country} ads on {account}?
checks: Says the account has no profile ID listed
Does not present a DSP advertiser ID, an entity ID, or any other number as its profile ID
Gives a concrete next step or explains what the account does have

cases.pick: A manager account with linked accounts.
cases.prompt: Which accounts are under our {manager} manager account? Is any of them another manager account, and is that the complete list?
checks: Reports the linked accounts with their count and types
Says none is typed as a manager account, or says this could not be confirmed
If the link query fails, says so and says completeness or nesting cannot be confirmed
Does not quote a fixed limit on linked accounts

cases.pick: An entity ID from a marketplace entry in an account's alternateIds.
cases.prompt: I found {entity_id} in an old spreadsheet. Which advertiser account and marketplace does it belong to?
checks: Gives the advertiser account's name and ID
Names the marketplace
Does not present the entity ID as the advertiser account ID

cases.pick: A DSP advertiser ID on a global account with no marketplace entries.
cases.prompt: Our DSP advertiser ID is {dsp_advertiser_id}. What advertiser account is that, and does it have a profile ID I can use?
checks: Gives the advertiser account's name and ID
Says the account has no profile ID listed
Does not present the DSP advertiser ID or any other number as its profile ID

cases.pick: A global account whose ID appears in a manager's linked rows, with a name no other account shares.
cases.prompt: Which manager account is our {account} advertiser account under? I need the manager account ID.
checks: Names the manager and gives its ID
States the listed link as a link, and does not say the question cannot be answered
If the link query fails, says other parents or nesting are unconfirmed

cases.pick: A login with at least two identities on this server. Skip this case on a login with one, and report the skip.
cases.prompt: How many advertiser accounts can I access in total? List their names.
checks: Shows each identity's label and region
Asks which identity to use or whether to search them all
Presents no number as the total for the login until those identities are searched

cases.pick: A login with at least two identities on this server. Skip this case on a login with one, and report the skip. This is the one case where the run prompt may allow set_active_identity, for the named identity only.
cases.prompt: How many advertiser accounts are on our {identity_label} login? List their names.
checks: Selects the named identity before any account query
Reports the distinct total across that identity's global and non-global accounts
Says the count covers that identity and that the login has others
